In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
understanding is a complex process involving the acquisition of a variety of knowledge and skills, and the application of these in the service of a range of purposes.
understanding is the ability to make sense of a complex phenomenon in a manner that integrates knowledge of facts, concepts, and generalizations with the ability to apply them in new situations.
understanding history involves the ability to make sense of the past, to interpret and evaluate historical evidence, and to use historical knowledge to explain the present.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

students understand history when they are able to: (1) recall historical knowledge; (2) apply historical methods, such as using primary sources; (3) identify the purposes of historical knowledge, including its role in society; and (4) identify the forms of historical knowledge, such as narratives, maps, or timelines.
students who understand history can explain, justify, and interpret the past, and they can make connections between the past and present (Boix Mansilla and Jackson 2001).

understanding history involves knowledge of historical facts and ideas, methods of analyzing and interpreting historical sources, purposes for learning about the past, and forms of historical thinking.
